headline: Edison announces the phonograph
post_facts: Sound was cut into tinfoil on a cylinder
First words: Mary Had a Little Lamb

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen seventy-seven... Thomas Edison announced a machine that could talk back.

scenes.label: Edison's tinfoil phonograph
scenes.caption: National Museum of American History
scenes.title: Sound cut into tinfoil
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] He called it the phonograph. A needle cut sound into tinfoil, on a turning cylinder.

scenes.label: Thomas Edison, 1878
scenes.caption: With his phonograph in Washington
scenes.title: First words: Mary Had a Little Lamb
scenes.text: [softly] His first test was a nursery rhyme... Mary had a little lamb.

scenes.label: months later, his patent was granted
scenes.text: [calmly] He received the patent in February, eighteen seventy-eight.

scenes.title: Sound could now be saved
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] For the first time... a voice could be saved, and played again.

scenes.title: Could you live without recorded music?
scenes.text: [gently] Could you live without recorded music?
